title: Bloowho went by by Moulang’s pipes bearing in his breast the sweets of sin, by Wine’s antiques, in memory bearing sweet sinful words, by Carroll’s dusky battered plate, for Raoul.
html_source:
Bloom hasn’t arrived at The Ormond yet. Like many men he is heading for the hotel and its sirens – Ms. Douce and Ms. Kennedy. Bloom is on Wellington Quay with the book ‘Sweets of Sin’ in his pocket.

Raoul is a character in Sweets of Sin, the pornographic book Leopold bought earlier in the day. Ms Douce and Ms. Kennedy do not sing or tempt Bloom at the bar.
